user_goal: Run the fixed complex blueprint test task from planning through archive.

agent_descriptions.requirements: Breaks down the user goal and fans out required work.
agent_descriptions.risk_scan: Scans requirements and architecture for risk level.
agent_descriptions.architecture: Creates implementation architecture and splits backend/frontend work.
agent_descriptions.test_planner: Creates the unit and end-to-end testing strategy.
agent_descriptions.unit_tests: Runs unit tests and publishes test results.
agent_descriptions.e2e_tests: Runs end-to-end tests and publishes test results.
agent_descriptions.security_review: Reviews high-risk paths before regular review.
agent_descriptions.review: Aggregates implementation, risk, and test inputs for review.
agent_descriptions.patch: Fixes review or integration failures and feeds retry work.
agent_descriptions.integration: Validates integrated changes and decides success or failure attribution.
agent_descriptions.failure_analysis: Classifies integration failure and produces retry guidance.
agent_descriptions.summary: Builds the final report and archive summary.

requirements.goal: Analyze the user goal and dispatch risk, architecture, and test-planning tasks through framework messaging.
requirements.expected_output: A complete outgoing batch for risk_scan, architecture, and test_planner.
requirements.acceptance: Every required downstream target receives a framework-queued message and the message journal is persisted.
